line: Thank your past self, in writing, for something you did.
paragraph: A 24-year-old woman in England had just asked for a sign when something extraordinary happened. A Eurasian kingfisher streaked toward her and landed on her hand. The small bird stayed there for ten minutes. The woman, Laura O'Brien, later told a news service that she was amazed. She said she had asked for a sign, and moments later this happened.
